note: Election of the aldermen and councillors of Newtownards Borough Council on 21 May 1958, reported ward by ward. Each of the four wards returned one alderman; Castle, Victoria and Glen also elected three councillors, while Scrabo's three councillors were unopposed. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
